arguments.text: Implemented evaluate(request, policy) in work.py: deduplicates declared paths, excludes policy.ignored, treats absent saved/current entries as {kind:missing}, compares complete states via canonical JSON, sorts changed paths, sets needs_review from changed, and does not mutate inputs. Local checks covered metadata-only changes, ignored paths, missing equivalence, JSON key-order equivalence, irrelevant undeclared changes, sorting/deduplication, and input immutability.
